defects_addressed.description: Combo BROKER_FEASIBILITY rejected nested canonical contract dicts (conId inside contract object) because validation only looked for flat keys.
defects_addressed.fix: Added _combo_leg_contract_spec and _combo_leg_contract_id helpers that accept both flat and nested contract shapes. Added BROKER_FEASIBILITY_COMBO_LEG_DUPLICATE rejection and BROKER_FEASIBILITY_COMBO_LEG_IDENTITY_CONFLICT for contradictory flat+nested IDs.

defects_addressed.description: Post-market orchestration not wired in production; service cycled indefinitely after close.
defects_addressed.fix: Added session_orchestration.py with classify_session over liquidHours/timeZoneId. Wired session_evidence_reader into autonomous_service via service_factory.

defects_addressed.description: DBL_MAX sentinel detection only checked float('inf'), missing exact IBKR sentinel 1.7976931348623157E308.
defects_addressed.fix: Added _is_unusable_broker_economic_value() helper detecting exact DBL_MAX string/float, inf, -inf, nan, and Decimal equivalents. Added broker_whatif_reached / broker_economics_computed fields with coherent what_if_status semantics (BROKER_WHATIF_NO_RESPONSE / BROKER_ECONOMICS_NOT_COMPUTED / BROKER_ECONOMICS_COMPUTED).

defects_addressed.description: Hard-coded reference symbols in research layer.
defects_addressed.fix: session_evidence now receives reference_symbols from caller. day1_launch passes MarketPolicyFreezer.REQUIRED_SYMBOLS. Regression test proves no duplication in research tools source.

defects_addressed.description: session_evidence stopped after first reference, did not require consensus.
defects_addressed.fix: All references must resolve, share timezone, and classify to same MarketSession. Returns None for missing, disagreeing, or malformed references. Includes broker_time_utc from single broker connection.

defects_addressed.description: Orchestration opened separate broker connection for broker_now after session_evidence already connected.
defects_addressed.fix: session_evidence now returns broker_time_utc. _session_orchestration_decision reuses it when present, avoiding second connection. Fallback to broker_now for legacy evidence.

defects_addressed.description: Two duplicate _what_if_evidence definitions existed in ibkr_research_tools.py, with the first one dead/shadowed.
defects_addressed.fix: Removed the dead first definition. Exactly one _what_if_evidence remains. Added regression test proving count == 1.

risks_remaining.risk: The remediation branch is not deployed to production runtime; it exists only as code and tests. Owner action is required to restart from the remediation branch before any live trading session.

BROKER_WHATIF_PASS was obtained while the market was closed in prior Oct 1 validation, so IBKR returned DBL_MAX margin sentinels and zero commission. The round trip to IBKR is proven (authoritative warningText returned, 1 whatIfOrder transmitted PAPER-only), but margin/commission computation for a combo during live session is NOT proven. A during-session re-validation is recommended before operational promotion.

Combo margin and commission computation by IBKR for a BAG order during live market session has not been end-to-end validated. The DBL_MAX sentinel detection is unit-tested but not exercised against a live IBKR whatIf response for a real BAG.

The orchestration decision treats PREMARKET as a non-trading session. If the experiment is ever intended to act premarket, that policy must be revisited by the Owner; it was chosen because the market-data gate already requires MarketSession.REGULAR.

explicitly_not_proven: Combo margin and commission computation by IBKR for a BAG order during live market session.
That a live Monday session resumes correctly in production; this is proven deterministically by tests, not by a live session.
Any claim about the model's trading quality, strategy, or profitability. No strategy, symbol, threshold, or universe was introduced by this work.
That any still-running baseline process is free of other latent defects; no baseline process was observed at report generation time.
